Pattern: Ines's mug location.
Assumption: I guessed kitchen_table_k1 for morning hours, assuming it stayed in the kitchen.
Reality: On day 20, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 10:50. It moves to the living room earlier than previously thought, by late morning.
Correction: Check coffee_table_l1 for late morning/afternoon. Do not guess kitchen spots after 10:00. If last confirmed location is older than 2 hours, ABSTAIN.

Pattern: Ines's water bottle location.
Assumption: I guessed dish_rack_k1 for late morning and coffee_table_l1 for evening, assuming a linear kitchen-to-living-room trajectory.
Reality: On day 20, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 11:19 (late morning) but back at kitchen_table_k1 at 20:14 (evening). It does not stay in the living room all day; it returns to the kitchen in the evening.
Correction: Check coffee_table_l1 for late morning/afternoon. Check kitchen_table_k1 for evening hours (after 18:00). Do not assume it stays in the living room overnight. If unsure, ABSTAIN.

Pattern: Ines's book location.
Assumption: I guessed bed_b1, assuming it was already in the bedroom.
Reality: On day 19, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 11:15. It stays in the living room during the day, moving to the bedroom only in the evening.
Correction: Check coffee_table_l1 or couch_l1 for daytime hours. Do not guess bedroom spots before 19:00. If unsure, ABSTAIN.

General Rule: Ines's items follow a non-linear daily trajectory: Kitchen (early morning) -> Living Room (late morning/afternoon) -> Kitchen (evening) -> Bedroom (night). The return to the kitchen in the evening is a key correction. Strict recency is required. If the last confirmed location is older than 2-3 hours, ABSTAIN. Do not extrapolate based on time of day alone without recent confirmation.
